text:
sophia: Heads up — I hit a 404/403 on the prompt-evals doc when following the artifact link, section 'test harness'. link: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/prompt-evals/artifacts/2026-03-01.zip @maria, did you own that page?

maria: yes, I co-authored that page. thanks for flagging. pulling it up now.

maria: quick scan — looks like the page points at an old bucket name (old-bucket). staging fetches 403, so we should switch to our internal shortlink or the new bucket.

kevin: if you're changing it, can you also add a frontmatter owner: prompts-team? small CR. @james can you review when ready?

james: on it. question: do we need a redirect from the old shortlink or is updating the doc sufficient? production may still have the old object live.

maria: plan: update to internal shortlink path `/kb/assets/prompt-evals/2026-03-01.zip` and add owner. I'll open a PR in ~30m. sed I'll run locally to patch: `sed -i 's|s3://old-bucket/prompt-evals|/kb/assets/prompt-evals|g' docs/prompt-evals.md`

deploy-bot: Deploy preview created for PR #1234 — https://deploy-previews/redwood/PR-1234. Checks: link-checker ❌ (1 broken), markdown-lint ✅.

sophia: :thumbsup: can you add a one-line curl smoke example so support can verify after merge? e.g. `curl -I https://deploy-previews/redwood/PR-1234/assets/prompt-evals/2026-03-01.zip`

maria: added `curl -I` example and a short ownership blurb. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — requesting review.

james: LGTM. tiny nit: prefer using the shortlink helper instead of raw path: ``{{asset "prompt-evals/2026-03-01.zip"}}`` so moved assets work across envs.

maria: good call — updated to use `{{asset ...}}`. also added `owner: prompts-team` in frontmatter. can we get docs-scan to pick up owner on the next run? @devex-bot

devex-bot: docs-scan scheduled — will detect frontmatter owners on next run (approx in 6h).

kevin: great. merge when CI is green. @maria ping me after merge so we can trigger a quick support alert and close the incident.

maria: merged at 6987654380. scheduled a brief support alert to #support 10m after merge. thanks all for the quick turnaround.
